motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that City Council INSTRUCT the Bureau of Sanitation (LASAN) to suspend CARE+ operations in areas impacted by environmental emergencies as declared by the City or State, and this suspension should be codified in the procedure guidelines. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council INSTRUCT LASAN to implement a posting protocol for any environmental emergencies suspension of homeless encampment cleanups, which is intended to provide notice to unhoused residents that cleanups will not occur. This should include the removal of posted notices and posting of cancellation notices, ideally no later than 12 hours prior to the originally posted start time, and require all suspended operations to be clearly communicated via postings at cooling centers/augmented shelters, social media, and any other public notification systems about the environmental crisis event. /z JUN 2 4 2026 I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council INSTRUCT LASAN to include their environmental emergencies protocol in all postings and notices provided to all unhoused residents. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council INSTRUCT the Los Angeles’s Emergency Management Department to ensure that LASAN is part of the activation that occurs as part of any environmental emergency response. PRESENTED BY YSABEL JURADO 1 Councilmember, 14th District SECONDED BY JUN 2 4 2026
title: Suspend CARE+ Operations / Environmental Emergencies
